# Aalborg Universitetshospital

Aalborg Universitetshospital is a Danish university hospital located in Region Nordjylland [^src1][^src2]. It appears in the corpus as the workplace of a member of the styregruppe (steering group) for the Danish ADHD-database, a national health-quality database that monitors the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2].

The hospital is mentioned twice, once each in the ADHD-database's 2023 and 2024 annual reports, both times in a listing of steering group members identified by their affiliated institution and region [^src1][^src2]. No further details about the hospital's role, activities, or specific personnel are given in the available data. The broader context of these documents concerns the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] steering group, which draws representatives from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organisations, and the Danish healthcare quality institute [^src1][^src2], and which reports on assessment and treatment outcomes for children, young people, and (in later data) adults with ADHD across Denmark.

No further details are available beyond the entity's identification as a Region Nordjylland institution tied to the steering group's membership.
